scope.description: Two consecutive real campaigns by node 1 in a fixed three-voter async cluster; all genuine first- and second-term grants are stored then delayed by transport and released in six fixed phases.
assumptions: PreVote disabled; no timers, configuration changes, snapshots, restarts or external term inputs during the measured suffix.
Sequential RawNode calls, reliable FIFO local append/apply workers; only network vote response delivery is delayed.
MemoryStorage models the stable vote completion boundary in a no-crash schedule.
excluded: General consensus correctness, split-brain history, client effects and physical crash durability.
Pre-vote, joint membership and arbitrary concurrent competing candidates.
A liveness guarantee that sufficient grants must produce leadership by a deadline.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: MemoryStorage replaces durable media in a no-crash model.
A deterministic transport holds actual VoteResp messages; local work remains reliable FIFO.
Public BasicStatus supplies the measured role and term. Driver counters derive only from delivered message identities.

plan_uncertainties: Only two consecutive non-pre-vote campaigns with fixed membership and six release checkpoints are covered.
No crash, competing leader or client-visible endpoint is observed.
